summary: TonersCart 12-item polish-patch backend testing: 15/15 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_polish_patch.py covering all features in the review_request. Smoke (GET /api/) OK. GET /api/featured/suppliers returns [] gracefully (no 500) with is_featured column not yet migrated. POST /api/featured/apply returns 200 with company+contact_person+phone+email+city+pincode+business_type+description (admin-notify + applicant auto-reply emails fire best-effort). POST /api/quotation rejects unauthenticated (401), accepts buyer JWT, returns 200 + quote_number matching ^TC-\d{8}-[A-Z0-9]{5}$ and sends Resend emails to buyer + BCC support. Bad listing_type → 400; unknown listing → 404. GET /api/listings/{id}/brochure with auth + listing without brochure → 404 'No brochure available' (NOT 500, verified). Auth gating on brochure endpoint enforced (401). Phone normalization: POST /api/orders accepts customer_phone '+91 9000099002' without 422/500. Commission constants confirmed: email_service._COMMISSION_TIERS == [(5000, 0.08), (25000, 0.06), (150000, 0.04)] and Deal-basis fallback above ₹1.5L. Public reads (/listings/search, /printers, /listings/facets) still 200 — no regression from adding spec_pdf_url to select clauses. Regression run on prior suites: test_supabase_backend (24/27 pass) + test_batch_fixes (29/29 pass) + test_polish_patch (15/15 pass) = 69 passed + 1 skipped + 3 failed; the 3 failures are PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to this patch (see backend_issues.minor).

minor.issue: Pre-existing field-name mismatch: after rejection, the applicant's role stays 'customer' and /auth/me sets only `application_status='rejected'`, never `supplier_status`. test_supabase_backend.py:198 asserts `supplier_status=='rejected'` and fails ('pending' returned). NOT caused by polish patch — same code path was present in iteration_5. Either update the API to also expose supplier_status for ex-applicants, or update the test.
Returns 500 'LLM key not configured (set GOOGLE_API_KEY in backend/.env to enable the chatbot)'. Pre-existing; only EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is in .env. Not part of this patch but blocks test_chat_llm.
If a listing has price=0 or no supplier_id (anomalous row), quotation still goes through with total=0 and the email is dispatched. Consider validating supplier existence + non-zero price.

Returns {ok: true} even when the underlying Supabase insert silently fails (migration pending). Acceptable per spec (graceful degrade) but the response gives no signal whether the row was persisted — consider an internal {persisted: bool} flag for ops/observability.

When the spec_pdf_url column is missing (current state), endpoint returns 404 'No brochure available' rather than distinguishing between 'no brochure uploaded' vs 'column not yet migrated'. Functionally correct per spec; flag for future when migration runs.

Raises 500 'is_featured column not yet migrated' if the migration has not run. Spec says other featured endpoints should degrade gracefully — this one is the exception (admin-only write). Consider downgrading to 503 with a clearer message.

action_items: (Pre-existing) /api/auth/me should also expose supplier_status='rejected' (or update test_supabase_backend.py:198 to assert application_status).
(Pre-existing) Add GOOGLE_API_KEY to backend/.env or skip the chat test when missing.
(Optional) Distinguish 'brochure column missing' (503) from 'no brochure on this listing' (404) once migration runs.
(Optional) PUT /api/admin/suppliers/{id}/featured should degrade to 503 instead of 500 when is_featured column is missing.

(Note for user) Run /app/backend/supabase_schema_quotation_featured.sql in Supabase to enable: featured_applications table, suppliers.is_featured, listings.spec_pdf_url, printer_listings.spec_pdf_url, quotations audit table. After migration, re-run test_polish_patch.py to confirm a real brochure round-trip and DB-persisted featured applications.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1631 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, listings, orders, admin, featured, quotation, brochure, chat).

POST /api/featured/apply currently does NO rate-limiting and NO captcha — a public unauthenticated endpoint that triggers two Resend emails per call is an email-bomb / quota-burn risk. Add a per-IP throttle and a simple honeypot field.

POST /api/quotation 502s if Resend fails but still does the audit insert with quote_number. On retry the buyer gets a second quote_number for the same intent. Consider returning 200 with `email_sent: false` so the FE toast can degrade, OR rolling back the audit row on email failure.

POST /api/orders does not normalize/validate customer_phone server-side — '+91 9000099002' is stored verbatim. Per the spec FE strips '+91', so backend should accept either but ideally normalize to E.164 before insert for downstream consistency.

GET /api/listings/{id}/brochure uses `listing_type` query param to pick table — no validation. Passing `listing_type=printers` (plural) silently falls through to the toner branch. Add a strict whitelist.
_COMMISSION_TIERS is duplicated in /app/backend/email_service.py and (presumably) /app/frontend/src/lib/commission.js. Single source of truth would prevent drift.

supabase admin client (sb_admin) is used everywhere with service-role; any RLS protections are bypassed. Most reads are fine, but writes to suppliers.is_featured / featured_applications should still be defense-in-depth (require_role check is the only gate).

After the user runs supabase_schema_quotation_featured.sql, re-run this suite — featured/suppliers may return rows, featured/apply will persist to DB, and brochure tests should still return 404 (no spec_pdf_url uploaded yet) but can be extended to upload via POST /api/supplier/spec-pdf and assert the signed-URL round-trip. The 3 pre-existing failures in test_supabase_backend (test_reject_supplier, test_reject_v2_empty_with_reason, test_chat_llm) are NOT regressions from this patch — confirmed by reviewing the touched server.py blocks (lines 1264-1530 are new; reject + chat code is untouched).
rca of the issue: No bug introduced by polish patch. The 3 pre-existing failures: (1) test_reject_supplier — /auth/me only sets `supplier_status` when role=='supplier'; rejected applicants keep role='customer', so supplier_status is undefined and only application_status='rejected' is exposed. Test asserts the wrong field. Fix is one-line in either server.py (line ~598: also set out['supplier_status'] = out['application_status']) or test (line 198: assert application_status). (2) test_chat_llm — GOOGLE_API_KEY missing in .env; spec note says emergentintegrations is preferred for LLM, so this is expected for current setup. (3) test_reject_v2_empty_with_reason — same root cause as (1).
